## Action inputs and comparisons

The driver decodes each raw TLMASA action with the production canonical codec before executing any new action. History pin decoding uses the strict original codec. It verifies origin/foundation/binding, every completed logical receipt, each original physical Before/After receipt, origin history and the continuous per-action physical chain. Recovery/supersession evidence, non-append native evidence, changed publications and unresolved/rejected appends are rejected before action execution. The complete bounded metadata history is opened under the same final-Post owner before source actions run.

Recorded Before and TLMAP Accepted bytes are comparison-only: they are read as opaque bytes and compared against the complete newly emitted observations. They do not construct tables, financial results, source exceptions, source PCs or scheduler decisions. Native candidate evidence is compared to the actual pending historical context; the original mutation blob is compared to the exact source-computed mutation bytes. Existing receipt publication rederives the financial commitment, field stream and head. The original checked-WAL head remains explicitly identified as the original metadata transcript head.

The code preserves source errors/API refusals as actual reexecuted observations rather than interpreting every throw as replay failure or supplying a successful result. An observation mismatch returns the actual executed prefix and retains the owned locks. It offers no retry or accepted hot-head escape. Hash equality is consistency against retained expectations, not authentication.

## One owner and held awaits

The sealed cold prefix is destructured into its one existing financial Replay and the same final-Post index/capability. Financial facts, raw foundation and completed receipts move into the existing financial-without-index carrier; no new financial Runtime/Ledger is constructed. Both success and failure privately retain the checked WAL reader/lock, final index/lock and opaque cold capability. Public accessors expose immutable diagnostics and clearly original-context receipts, not a mutable Runtime/index, ordinary Session, Replay, checkpoint, capability release or live owner.

Historical catchup uses the common original financial/bootstrap/grouping and RowPC loops. Its query backend reads actual historical Directory/page snapshots; mutation names refuse. Kernel calls may borrow only the same capability-bound final index, whose write guard remains installed. A live block is refused before the missing inline block source/native work. This is a bounded missing-domain refusal, not inline-success parity.

AppendPending only verifies exact source-derived TLNM mutations and original complete Post/directory; it holds the same actual row await. ResolvePost alone resolves that same await and continues the shared source PC. The underlying playback's `complete()` also requires its active await to be absent, so merely reaching the final native Post cannot satisfy the terminal resolved-await admission. No append or capability release occurs in the new controller.

The two new independent real metadata controls cover:

1. A 72-row, multiple-page original snapshot with two suffix-colliding raw IDs. The source findOne chooses original sorted `tx-11-same` before `tx-2-same`. After verifying a real recorded append, new source reads see its actual Post while the retained grouping read still returns the complete original Before. Applied Post remains incomplete until the same await resolves. No additional native byte is appended during playback.
2. Every mutation spelling admitted to the backend dispatch is refused by the historical read interface before IO; the same pin, complete rows and append counters remain unchanged. Its bound capability can still be finished only by the owning test after playback is dropped.

These tests are metadata inputs/operations, not supplied financial validation answers or a substitute financial executor.

## Existing Core test coverage and limits

The three proposed actual-Core tests exercise complete Start/Pause ACK reconstruction; genuine native Append/Resolve with paused/timer/shutdown variants; and a raw observation-limit mismatch after actual Start, retaining that executed prefix and both locks. Their setup uses original raw reference inputs and compares financial state only after execution. They remain Parent's actual-Core gate.

Admission stays **HISTORY-WAL**, one available original publication, supported completed-prefix origin and terminally resolved native awaits. Mode4/inline escrow history, native ambiguity/supersession, cross-publication replay, hot-owner release and killed-process financial replay remain outside this candidate. The reader is not widened to ESCROW-WAL. This bounded review found no reason to change those fences.

No Root files, frozen packages, Cargo Core builds, Git state or financial snapshots were changed. Integration and its commit remain Parent-owned.
